# AI/ML & LLM Roadmap

## Foundations
- Python programming, NumPy, Pandas
- Linear algebra, calculus, probability basics
- Data preprocessing, feature engineering
- Exploratory data analysis (EDA) workflows

## Machine Learning
- Supervised learning: regression, classification, ensemble methods
- Unsupervised learning: clustering, dimensionality reduction
- Model evaluation: cross-validation, metrics (precision, recall, F1, ROC-AUC)
- Scikit-learn ecosystem

## Deep Learning
- Neural networks fundamentals, backpropagation
- CNNs for computer vision basics
- RNNs, LSTMs for sequence data
- Transfer learning, fine-tuning pre-trained models

## Natural Language Processing
- Text preprocessing, tokenization, embeddings
- Transformers architecture overview
- BERT, GPT, and modern LLM architectures
- Tokenization strategies, context windows

## LLM & RAG Development
- LangChain framework: chains, agents, retrievers
- Vector databases: FAISS, Pinecone, Chroma
- Embeddings: text-embedding models, similarity search
- RAG architecture: retrieval, augmentation, generation
- Prompt engineering: system prompts, few-shot, structured output
- Document chunking strategies (RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter)

## LLM Operations
- API integration: OpenAI, Gemini, Claude
- Token management, cost optimization
- Rate limiting, retry logic, fallback strategies
- Streaming responses for better UX

## MERN + AI Integration
- Building AI features into existing MERN applications
- Firebase auth for AI API security
- Combining user profile data with LLM context
- Building AI career advisor, skill matcher, mentor recommender

## Projects
- RAG-based career advisor over roadmap documents
- Skill gap analyzer using LLM with user profile context
- AI mentor matching with explainable recommendations
- Chat summarizer for conversation history

## Career paths
- ML Engineer: production ML, MLOps, model serving
- AI Engineer: LLM integration, RAG systems, prompt engineering
- Data Scientist: experimentation, causal inference, analytics
- Applied AI: building AI features into existing products

# Blockchain, Web3 & Smart Contract Engineering Roadmap

## 1. Blockchain Fundamentals & Cryptographic Foundations
- **Distributed Ledger Principles:** Peer-to-peer gossip networking, Cryptographic hash functions (SHA-256, Keccak-256), Digital Signatures (ECDSA secp256k1), Merkle Trees & Merkle Proofs for efficient state verification.
- **Consensus Mechanisms:** Proof of Work (Nakamoto consensus, 51% attack vectors), Proof of Stake (Validators, Slashing, Finality via Casper / Tendermint), Delegated Proof of Stake (DPoS), Practical Byzantine Fault Tolerance (pBFT).
- **Accounts Model vs UTXO Model:** Bitcoin UTXO (Unspent Transaction Output) vs Ethereum Account-Based Model (EOA - Externally Owned Accounts vs Contract Accounts, Nonce, Balance, Storage Root, Code Hash).

## 2. Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM) & Smart Contract Development
- **Solidity Programming:**
  - Data types: `uint256`, `address`, `bytes32`, mappings, structs, dynamic arrays.
  - Storage vs Memory vs Calldata: Gas implications of storage reads (`SLOAD` 2100 gas) vs memory reads (`MLOAD` 3 gas), storage slot layout (32-byte packing optimization).
  - Function Visibility & State Mutability: `public`, `private`, `internal`, `external`; `view`, `pure`, `payable`.
  - Fallback & Receive functions: handling raw Ether transfers.
- **Standards & Protocols:**
  - ERC-20 (Fungible Tokens: `transfer`, `approve`, `transferFrom`, allowance race condition defenses).
  - ERC-721 & ERC-1155 (Non-Fungible Tokens & Semi-Fungible multi-tokens).
  - ERC-4626 (Tokenized Vault Standard for DeFi yield strategies).

- ERC-4626 (Tokenized Vault Standard for DeFi yield strategies).
  - ERC-4337 (Account Abstraction: Smart contract wallets, Bundlers, Paymasters for gasless transactions).

## 3. Smart Contract Security & Auditing
- **Common Vulnerabilities:**
  - Reentrancy (The DAO hack): Checks-Effects-Interactions pattern, OpenZeppelin `ReentrancyGuard` mutex.
  - Integer Overflow/Underflow (Solidity 0.8+ native safe math).
  - Front-running & MEV (Maximal Extractable Value): Slippage parameters, Commit-Reveal schemes, Flashbots Protect.
  - Flash Loan Attacks: Price oracle manipulation (defense: Chainlink decentralized oracle networks, TWAP - Time-Weighted Average Price).
- **Security Tools:** Slither (Static analysis), Echidna (Property-based fuzzing), Mythril, Foundry test framework with fuzz testing (`vm.prank`, `vm.warp`).

## 4. Web3 Full-Stack Integration & Layer 2 Scaling
- **Libraries:** ethers.js, viem, wagmi (React hooks for Ethereum), Web3Modal / RainbowKit for wallet connections (MetaMask, WalletConnect).
- **Layer 2 Scaling Solutions:** Rollups (Optimistic Rollups: Arbitrum, Optimism using fraud proofs; ZK-Rollups: zkSync, Starknet using validity proofs / zk-SNARKs/zk-STARKs), Sidechains (Polygon).

# Career Guides for Tech Learners

## Choosing a direction
- Map **teachSkills** (strengths) vs **learnSkills** (growth) to role families: Frontend, Backend, Full-stack, Data, DevOps.
- Align **teachLevel** and **learnLevel** (Beginner → Mastery) with project difficulty and mentor expectations.
- Use education and portfolio to signal credibility; supplement with GitHub and live demos.

## Job search strategy
- Target roles where your teach skills overlap job requirements; use learn skills as upside narrative.
- Network via mentorship platforms: offer help in strong skills while learning weak areas.
- Prepare STAR stories from collaborative projects (matching, chat, ratings).

## Skill gap analysis method
1. List target role required skills (from job posts or roadmaps).
2. Mark owned (teach), learning (learn), missing.
3. Prioritize gaps that unblock portfolio pieces in 2–4 weeks.
4. Pair each gap with one course module + one project task.

## Learning habits
- 70% building, 20% reading docs, 10% community (mentors, peer review).
- Ship weekly: small PRs, demo links, changelog in README.
- Request feedback from mentors on code structure, not just syntax.

## Bangladesh / university context
- Leverage university projects (e.g., Daffodil International University) as case studies.
- Contribute to open source or local hackathons for visibility.
- Balance FYP deadlines with portfolio polish—one flagship app beats five half-done repos.

## Using mentorship effectively
- Come with specific questions: "Review my React state design" vs "teach me everything."
- Match mentors whose teachSkills cover your top 3 learnSkills.
- Follow up with implemented feedback to build reputation on the platform.

# High-Level & Low-Level System Design (HLD/LLD) & Distributed Systems

## 1. Core Distributed Systems Principles
- **CAP Theorem & PACELC Theorem:** Consistency, Availability, Partition Tolerance; Latency vs Consistency trade-offs in distributed networks.
- **Consistency Models:** Strong Consistency, Linearizability, Sequential Consistency, Eventual Consistency, Read-After-Write Consistency, Monotonic Reads.
- **Consensus & Coordination:** Raft consensus algorithm (Leader election, Log replication), Paxos, Gossip Protocol, Apache ZooKeeper, etcd.
- **Clock Synchronization & Ordering:** Lamport timestamps, Vector clocks, NTP drift, TrueTime (Google Spanner).

## 2. Scalability Architecture & Building Blocks
- **Load Balancing:** Layer 4 (Transport TCP/UDP via IPVS/HAProxy) vs Layer 7 (Application HTTP/HTTPS via Nginx, Envoy, AWS ALB). Algorithms: Round Robin, Weighted Least Connections, Consistent Hashing (Virtual nodes for minimal remapping on node failure).
- **Caching Strategies:**
  - Cache-Aside (Lazy loading), Write-Through, Write-Behind (Write-Back), Refresh-Ahead.
  - Eviction Policies: LRU (Least Recently Used), LFU, FIFO.
  - Cache Invalidation & Stampede (Thundering herd problem): Cache stampede locks, Probabilistic early expiration (XFetch).
  - Distributed Caching: Redis Cluster, Memcached.
- **Message Queues & Event-Driven Architecture:**

- Distributed Caching: Redis Cluster, Memcached.
- **Message Queues & Event-Driven Architecture:**
  - Kafka (Distributed commit log, Consumer groups, Partitions, Offsets, Exactly-once semantics via transactional producers), RabbitMQ (AMQP, Exchanges: Direct, Fanout, Topic, Dead-letter exchanges).
- **Database Scaling & Partitioning:**
  - Vertical vs Horizontal scaling (Sharding).
  - Sharding Keys: Range-based sharding, Hash-based sharding, Directory-based sharding; Cross-shard joins & transactions (2PC - Two Phase Commit, Saga Pattern).
  - Read Replicas & Replication Lag, Master-Slave vs Master-Master replication.

## 3. Real-World System Design Case Studies
- **URL Shortener (e.g. TinyURL):** Base62 encoding, MD5/SHA-256 collision handling, Token service / range allocation for scale.
- **Chat System (e.g. WhatsApp / Slack):** WebSockets, Socket.io, Long polling, Redis Pub/Sub, Presence system (Heartbeat intervals), Message storage in Cassandra / MongoDB.
- **Rate Limiter:** Token Bucket, Leaky Bucket, Fixed Window Counter, Sliding Window Log, Sliding Window Counter (Redis Sorted Sets).
- **Video Streaming (e.g. Netflix / YouTube):** Adaptive Bitrate Streaming (HLS, MPEG-DASH), Transcoding pipeline, CDN edge caching.
- **Distributed Unique ID Generator:** Twitter Snowflake (Timestamp + Datacenter ID + Worker ID + Sequence number).

# Comprehensive Cybersecurity & Ethical Hacking Engineering Roadmap

## Core Domains
1. **Network & Protocol Security:**
   - Deep mastery of the OSI model and TCP/IP stack: TCP 3-way handshake, UDP, DNS, DHCP, TLS/SSL (v1.2, v1.3 handshake & cipher suites), HTTP/1.1 vs HTTP/2 & HTTP/3 (QUIC).
   - Packet Inspection: Wireshark deep packet analysis, tcpdump, Nmap network scanning (SYN scan, ACK scan, Service version detection, NSE scripts).
   - Firewalls, IDS/IPS (Suricata, Snort), WAF (Cloudflare, AWS WAF, ModSecurity).

2. **Web Application Security (OWASP Top 10):**
   - **Injection:** SQL Injection (Union-based, Boolean-based, Blind time-based), Command Injection, NoSQL Injection, LDAP Injection.
   - **Broken Authentication & Session Management:** JWT vulnerabilities (None algorithm, weak secrets, key confusion, signature stripping), Session fixation, CSRF, OAuth 2.0 / OIDC security misconfigurations.
   - **XSS (Cross-Site Scripting):** Stored XSS, Reflected XSS, DOM-based XSS; Content Security Policy (CSP) bypass analysis.
   - **Access Control:** IDOR (Insecure Direct Object Reference), Privilege Escalation (Horizontal & Vertical), BOLA (Broken Object Level Authorization in APIs).
   - **SSRF (Server-Side Request Forgery):** Cloud metadata exploitation (AWS 169.254.169.254, GCP metadata header).

3. **Cryptography & Security Engineering:**
   - Symmetric Encryption: AES-GCM (Authenticated Encryption), AES-CBC (Padding Oracle vulnerabilities), ChaCha20-Poly1305.
   - Asymmetric Encryption & Key Exchange: RSA, Diffie-Hellman, ECDH (Elliptic Curve), Ed25519 digital signatures.
   - Cryptographic Hashing & Passwords: SHA-256, SHA-512, bcrypt, Argon2id, PBKDF2; rainbow table defenses with high-entropy salts.
   - PKI (Public Key Infrastructure), Certificate Authorities (CAs), mTLS (Mutual TLS for zero-trust microservices).

4. **Offensive & Defensive Security Operations:**
   - **Penetration Testing:** Reconnaissance (OSINT, subfinder, amass, ffuf), exploitation frameworks (Metasploit, Burp Suite Professional, OWASP ZAP), post-exploitation and privilege escalation (LinPEAS, WinPEAS).
   - **SOC & Incident Response:** SIEM platforms (Splunk, Elastic SIEM), MITRE ATT&CK framework mapping, memory forensics (Volatility), reverse engineering (Ghidra, IDA Pro).
   - **DevSecOps:** SAST (SonarQube, Semgrep), DAST (OWASP ZAP), SCA (Snyk, Dependabot), container image scanning (Trivy).

# Database Engineering, Storage Engines & Data Architecture

## 1. Relational Database Internals (RDBMS / PostgreSQL & MySQL)
- **ACID Transaction Guarantees:**
  - **Atomicity:** All-or-nothing execution via WAL (Write-Ahead Logging) and undo logs.
  - **Consistency:** Database schema constraints, foreign keys, assertions.
  - **Isolation Levels & Anomalies:** Read Uncommitted (Dirty read), Read Committed (Non-repeatable read), Repeatable Read (Phantom read), Serializable. Implementation: MVCC (Multi-Version Concurrency Control) and 2PL (Two-Phase Locking).
  - **Durability:** Fsync, WAL flushing to disk, checkpointing mechanisms.
- **Indexing Data Structures:**
  - B-Trees & $B^+$ Trees: Balanced height, fan-out, branch nodes, leaf node linked lists for range scans ($O(\log N)$ point lookup, sequential disk I/O).
  - Hash Indexes ($O(1)$ equality only).

- Hash Indexes ($O(1)$ equality only).
  - LSM-Trees (Log-Structured Merge-Trees used in RocksDB, Cassandra): Write amplification vs Read amplification, MemTable (in-memory skiplist), Commit Log, SSTables (Sorted String Tables) on disk, Compaction (Size-tiered vs Leveled), Bloom filters for fast non-existence checks.
  - GIN (Generalized Inverted Index) for full-text search and JSONB containment in PostgreSQL; GiST and SP-GiST for spatial/geometric data.
- **Query Optimization & Execution Plans:**
  - `EXPLAIN ANALYZE`: Seq Scan (COLLSCAN) vs Index Scan vs Index Only Scan vs Bitmap Index Scan.
  - Join Algorithms: Nested Loop Join ($O(M \times N)$), Hash Join ($O(M + N)$ with build & probe phases), Merge Join (requires sorted inputs, $O(M \log M + N \log N)$).

## 2. NoSQL & Distributed Databases
- **Document Stores:** MongoDB (BSON format, WiredTiger storage engine, WiredTiger cache, replica sets with Raft-like election, oplog replication, sharded clusters with mongos query router and config servers).
- **Key-Value & In-Memory:** Redis (Single-threaded event loop, RESP protocol, in-memory data structures: Strings, Hashes, Lists, Sets, Sorted Sets with Skiplist, HyperLogLog, Streams, Persistence: RDB snapshots & AOF append-only file with fsync policies).
- **Wide-Column Stores:** Apache Cassandra / ScyllaDB (Masterless architecture, Dynamo ring topology, Consistent hashing, Tunable consistency: ONE, QUORUM, ALL).
- **Graph Databases:** Neo4j (Index-free adjacency, Cypher query language, Graph traversals).

## 3. Vector Databases for AI & Embeddings
- Vector Indexing algorithms: HNSW (Hierarchical Navigable Small World graphs - high recall, low latency), IVF-PQ (Inverted File with Product Quantization - compressed memory footprint), Annoy.
- Distance Metrics: Cosine Similarity, Euclidean Distance (L2), Dot Product / Inner Product.
- Tools: Pinecone, Qdrant, Milvus, ChromaDB, pgvector (PostgreSQL vector extension), Atlas Vector Search.

# Data Structures, Algorithms & Competitive Programming (DSA) Mastery

## 1. Algorithmic Complexity & Foundations
- **Asymptotic Notation:** Big-O, Big-Omega, Big-Theta; Time and space complexity trade-offs.
- **Recursion & Master Theorem:** Divide and conquer recurrences $T(n) = aT(n/b) + f(n)$.
- **Bit Manipulation:** Bitwise operators (&, |, ^, ~, <<, >>), Two's complement, Brian Kernighan's algorithm, XOR trick for unique element, subset generation via bitmasks.

## 2. Core & Advanced Data Structures
- **Linear Structures:** Dynamic Arrays, Singly & Doubly Linked Lists, Circular Queues, Deque, Monotonic Stacks (Next Greater Element), Monotonic Queues (Sliding Window Maximum).
- **Trees & Hierarchies:** Binary Search Trees (BST), AVL Trees & Red-Black Trees (Self-balancing invariants, rotations), Trie (Prefix Tree, Aho-Corasick), Segment Trees (Point updates, Range queries, Lazy Propagation), Fenwick Tree (Binary Indexed Tree).
- **Disjoint Set Union (DSU):** Union by rank/size, Path compression, Cycle detection in undirected graphs.
- **Heaps & Priority Queues:** Min-Heap, Max-Heap, Binary Heap properties, Median finding in a stream.

## 3. Algorithmic Paradigms & Patterns
- **Two Pointers & Sliding Window:** Opposite direction, Same direction, Variable length window, Fixed length window.
- **Binary Search on Answer:** Monotonic search spaces, Lower bound / Upper bound implementations, Capacity scheduling problems.
- **Graph Algorithms:**
  - Traversal: BFS (Shortest path in unweighted graph), DFS (Connected components, Cycle detection, Topological sort via Kahn's / DFS).
  - Shortest Paths: Dijkstra (Non-negative weights, $O((V+E)\log V)$), Bellman-Ford (Negative weights, Negative cycle detection), Floyd-Warshall ($O(V^3)$ All-pairs).
  - Minimum Spanning Tree: Kruskal (with DSU), Prim's algorithm.
  - Bridge & Articulation Points: Tarjan's bridge-finding algorithm, Strongly Connected Components (Kosaraju, Tarjan).
  - Network Flow: Ford-Fulkerson, Edmonds-Karp, Dinic's algorithm.
- **Dynamic Programming (DP):**

- Network Flow: Ford-Fulkerson, Edmonds-Karp, Dinic's algorithm.
- **Dynamic Programming (DP):**
  - Patterns: 0/1 Knapsack, Unbounded Knapsack, Longest Common Subsequence (LCS), Longest Increasing Subsequence (LIS $O(n\log n)$ with patience sorting), Matrix Chain Multiplication, Digit DP, Bitmask DP (Traveling Salesman Problem), DP on Trees.
  - State design, Transition equations, Base cases, Space optimization (Tabulation rolling arrays).
- **String Algorithms:** KMP (Knuth-Morris-Pratt $\pi$-table), Rabin-Karp polynomial rolling hash, Z-algorithm, Suffix Arrays.

## 4. Competitive Programming Strategy (Codeforces, LeetCode, ICPC)
- Rating Progression: Division 4 (Fundamentals) -> Division 3 (DSA Implementations) -> Division 2 (Complex DP & Graphs) -> Division 1.
- Benchmarks: LeetCode Medium/Hard for FAANG/Tier-1 interviews; Fast I/O in C++ (`ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false); cin.tie(NULL);`).

# Mobile Application Engineering & Cross-Platform Systems

## 1. Cross-Platform Frameworks
- **React Native:**
  - Architecture: Old Bridge architecture (JSON serialization over async bridge) vs New Architecture (TurboModules for synchronous C++ JSI calls, Fabric Renderer, Codegen, Hermes JavaScript engine).
  - State Management: Redux Toolkit, Zustand, TanStack Query (React Query) for server state caching.
  - Native Navigation: React Navigation (Stack, Tabs, Drawer), Native stack navigator performance benefits.
- **Flutter & Dart:**
  - Architecture: Skia / Impeller 2D graphics rendering engine directly to platform canvas (no native widget translation overhead), AOT (Ahead-Of-Time) compiled ARM machine code.
  - State Management: BLoC (Business Logic Component with Streams), Riverpod (compile-safe dependency injection), Provider.
  - Widget Tree: StatelessWidget, StatefulWidget, RenderObject, Element tree, Hot Reload mechanism.

## 2. Native Mobile Engineering
- **Android (Kotlin):**
  - Jetpack Compose declarative UI, ViewModel, LiveData / StateFlow, Coroutines & Flow for asynchronous tasks, Room Database (SQLite ORM), Hilt / Dagger dependency injection, WorkManager for background processing.
- **iOS (Swift):**
  - SwiftUI declarative UI, Combine framework, Swift Concurrency (`async`/`await`, Actors for thread safety), CoreData / SwiftData, URLSession, BackgroundTasks framework.

## 3. Production Mobile Architecture & Best Practices
- **Offline-First Synchronization:** Local persistence via SQLite, WatermelonDB (reactive SQLite for React Native), Realm; Optimistic UI updates, Conflict resolution strategies (Last-Write-Wins, CRDTs).
- **Deep Linking & Universal Links:** Android App Links (assetlinks.json), iOS Universal Links (apple-app-site-association), Custom URL schemes.
- **Push Notifications:** Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM), Apple Push Notification service (APNs), notification payload handling in foreground, background, and killed states.
- **Performance Profiling:** Memory leaks (leakcanary), FPS profiling (target 60/120fps), App bundle size reduction (ProGuard, R8 shrinking, Dynamic Feature Modules).

# Computer Systems, Operating Systems, Embedded Engineering & IoT

## 1. Computer Systems Architecture & Low-Level Foundations
- **Processor Architecture:** Von Neumann vs Harvard architecture, CPU registers, Instruction Pipeline (Fetch, Decode, Execute, Memory, Write-back), Pipeline hazards (Structural, Data, Control - Branch prediction), Cache Hierarchy (L1, L2, L3 cache lines, Cache coherency MESI protocol).
- **C & C++ Systems Programming:** Manual memory management (`malloc`, `free`, pointers, pointer arithmetic, memory leaks, buffer overflows), RAII in C++, smart pointers (`std::unique_ptr`, `std::shared_ptr`, `std::weak_ptr`), Memory layout of a process (Code segment, Data, BSS, Heap, Stack).
- **Modern Systems with Rust:** Ownership, Borrowing, Lifetimes (`'a`), Zero-cost abstractions, Concurrency safety without garbage collection, unsafe Rust boundaries.

## 2. Operating Systems Internals
- **Processes vs Threads:** PCB (Process Control Block), Context switching overhead, Fork-Exec model, Inter-Process Communication (IPC: Pipes, Shared memory, Message queues, UNIX domain sockets).
- **Concurrency & Synchronization:** Race conditions, Critical sections, Atomic operations (Compare-And-Swap), Mutexes, Spinlocks, Semaphores (Counting & Binary), Condition variables, Deadlocks (Coffman conditions, Banker's algorithm, Deadlock detection & recovery).
- **Virtual Memory & Paging:** Page tables, Multi-level paging, TLB (Translation Lookaside Buffer), Page faults, Page replacement algorithms (LRU, Clock, Optimal), Memory-mapped files (`mmap`).
- **File Systems & Storage:** Inodes, Superblocks, Journaling file systems (ext4, XFS), VFS (Virtual File System) abstraction.

## 3. Embedded Systems & Microcontrollers
- **Microcontrollers vs Microprocessors:** Arduino (AVR ATmega328P), ESP32 / ESP8266 (Tensilica dual-core, built-in Wi-Fi & Bluetooth BLE), ARM Cortex-M series (STM32).
- **Hardware Protocols:** GPIO (General Purpose Input/Output), UART (Universal Asynchronous Receiver-Transmitter), I2C (Inter-Integrated Circuit - two-wire, Master/Slave addressing), SPI (Serial Peripheral Interface - four-wire full-duplex), CAN bus (Controller Area Network for automotive/industrial).
- **Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS):** FreeRTOS (Task scheduling, Preemption, Queues, Semaphores, Tickless idle mode for low-power operation), Hard real-time vs Soft real-time constraints.

## 4. Internet of Things (IoT) & Edge Computing
- **IoT Communication Protocols:** MQTT (Publish/Subscribe, lightweight, QoS 0/1/2, Last Will and Testament), CoAP (Constrained Application Protocol over UDP), WebSockets, LoRaWAN (Long Range Wide Area Network for low-power remote sensors).
- **Edge Computing & Embedded AI:** TinyML (TensorFlow Lite for Microcontrollers), Edge Impulse, Sensor fusion (IMU, Accelerometer, Gyroscope filtering via Kalman filters).
